evidence: Template library shows 6 templates, each with author (e.g. Sarah Chen), description, use count, category/type tags, update date.
Each template card shows name (Professional Resume), author (Sarah Chen), description, type tag (Resume/Business), and update time (Updated 2024-12-01).
Clicking "Use Template" opened a modal dialog for the Professional Resume template with its fill form.
Filled all 14 form fields (Full Name, Job Title, Email, Phone, Summary, Company, Position, dates, Responsibilities, Degree, School, Grad Year, Skills) successfully via form inputs.
After filling required fields, clicking "Preview Result" tab displayed rendered resume with all entered data formatted properly.

Preview shows John Smith heading, Software Engineer title, email/phone, summary, experience with Tech Corp — Senior Developer, dates, responsibilities, education, and skills — all matching entered form data in proper Markdown-rendered structure.
Preview rendered with correct headings (h1/h2/h3), bold/emphasis formatting, and separator — no formatting errors observed.
Before filling required fields, "Preview Result" tab was disabled and a "Required fields missing" warning listed missing fields; after filling, the tab became enabled.
Warning banner "Required fields missing" with list of missing fields shown, and Preview tab visually disabled, when required fields empty.
"Copy to Clipboard" button present in Preview tab; clicking it executed without error, and clipboard.writeText API confirmed functional in page context.

actual: Typed "￥#@%^*" into the required Full Name field; all special characters were accepted as-is (field showed "￥#@%^*John Smith") with no filtering and no "Special characters are prohibited" message displayed.

issue: No visual feedback for special character input
actual: Entering special characters (￥#@%^*) into Full Name field produced no visual feedback (no error text, no highlight, no blocked input) — characters were simply accepted.
Entered an invalid date "35/99/2020" into the required Start Date field; it was accepted with no validation error or format enforcement.
Set Start Date to "Jan 2025" and End Date to "Jan 2020" (end earlier than start); no validation error was shown and the form accepted the values without restriction.

evidence: Clicking heart icon on "Professional Resume" card changed button class to "bg-primary/10 text-primary" and heart SVG gained "fill-current" class, visually indicating favorited state.
Clicking heart icon favorited "Professional Resume"; Favorites counter badge showed "1".
Clicking "Favorites" button filtered the template list to show only the favorited "Professional Resume" template ("Showing 1 of 6 templates").
Category filter (Resume→1 result), Scenario filter (Academic→1 result), and Sort By (Most Popular descending by uses; Recently Updated descending by date) all worked correctly.

issue: Search does not support fuzzy matching
actual: Typing the misspelled keyword "reprot" (intended: "report") returned "0 of 6 templates" / "No templates found", with no suggestions shown — indicating exact substring matching only, not fuzzy matching.

evidence: Typing "resu" showed a real-time suggestion "Professional Resume" below the search box; clicking it set the search box to "Professional Resume" and filtered the list to display only that corresponding template.
As "resu" was typed, results list updated live from "6 of 6" to "1 of 6" showing only the Professional Resume template, without needing to submit the search.

Submitting the "Submit a Template" form with empty Title, Author Name, and Content fields triggered a toast: "Missing required fields - Please fill in all required fields." and the form was not submitted.

Submitted a Markdown template with title, author, description, category, scenario, content with {{name}} field syntax, and a defined "name" field. Toast confirmed "Template submitted! Your template has been added to the library."
Immediately after submission, "QA Test Template" appeared in the public library list (count went from 6 to 7), visible to browse and use like other templates.

Template library list updated instantly and synchronously after submission, showing "Showing 7 of 7 templates" with the new "QA Test Template" card displayed with correct author, description, category tag, and update date (2026-09-02).

issue: No Markdown syntax validation on submission
actual: Submitted a template with deliberately broken Markdown (unclosed bold **, unclosed image/link syntax, unclosed code fence, malformed table). It was accepted without any syntax validation or warning — toast simply showed "Template submitted! Your template has been added to the library," and the template was added to the library as-is.
